authorization: Owner instruction P61.3 (2026-11-10): resolve the unresolved Alex Morgan synthetic series where scientifically valid, normalize typographic unit differences only where equivalence is unambiguous, and record every other mapping as a Researcher-reviewable proposal. This register never approves anything; the application never writes it.
fixture: fixtures/synthetic/p61/Alex_Morgan_304_Observations.csv (and the companion PDF): 304 observations, 38 series, 8 dates

categories.SAFE_DETERMINISTIC_NORMALIZATION: Same name as an active entry; the unit differs only by a listed typographic notation rule. Applied to synthetic data only; Researcher confirmation of the rule is still required.
categories.EXISTING_IDENTITY_REQUIRES_ALIAS_APPROVA: An existing catalog identity very probably measures the same quantity, but the incoming name is not a reviewed alias. Held until a Researcher approves the alias.
categories.MISSING_CANONICAL_DEFINITION: No catalog entry exists. A new definition must pass the governed P36/P37 submission, Researcher approval and separate activation; it is never added silently.
categories.AMBIGUOUS_SPECIMEN_OR_METHOD: The name or source does not establish the specimen, measurement definition or recording method the candidate entry requires.
categories.INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE: The only supporting detail is an unverified source note; it cannot establish identity on its own.
categories.PROVISIONAL_SYNTHETIC_ALIAS: P61.2 owner-directed synthetic-only alias (exact unit), applied but pending Researcher review.

decisions.label: Body temperature

verification.method: Measurement site not recorded (source note "Method unspecified"); the catalog entry records no site either, so nothing is invented.
verification.unit: "deg C" is degree Celsius written in plain text (rule UN-1); stored as °C with the verbatim "deg C" kept; no conversion.
verification.domain: immune, as recorded on the active signed demo entry.

evidence: Identical name to the ACTIVE signed MITO_DEMO_2026 entry demo:ubt-323050f4.
uncertainty: Oral, tympanic, axillary and core temperatures differ; site-specific interpretation needs the method recorded.

approval.path: Researcher confirmation of the typographic notation rule UN-1; applied meanwhile to synthetic demo data only.

decisions.label: Platelets

verification.method: Automated blood count assumed by the candidate entry; not stated in the source.
verification.unit: "10^9/L" is "10⁹/L" written with a caret (rule UN-2). The demo entry demo:ubt-c4b4d258 uses 10^3/μL — a different unit expression — and is never used.

evidence: "Platelets" is the usual short form of "Platelet count" but is not a reviewed alias.
cv-058 is a production reference entry pending independent review.
uncertainty: Aliasing a production entry needs a governed decision even for synthetic data.

approval.path: Governed catalog extension (data/scientific/catalog-extensions.v1.json) with a named Researcher, decision time and handbook evidence, plus confirmation of rule UN-2.
